scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia! Do you know Moscovia?
the paradise spreading on the endless seas...
Welcome to Moscovia
It's adventurous and mystic.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
莫斯科比亚！你知道莫斯科比亚吗？
那是 spread 在无尽海洋上的天堂……
欢迎来到莫斯科比亚
这里充满冒险与神秘。

scripts.text: About Moscovia...
scripts.translation: 关于莫斯科比亚……

scripts.text: Go to Moscovia.
scripts.translation: 前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia is a beautiful kingdom
on an island located north of Rune-
Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
莫斯科比亚是位于卢恩·米德加兹北方岛屿上的美丽王国。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sure that you will be
absolutely fascinated
by Moscovia's beautiful scenery
and gorgeous palace.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
我相信你一定会被莫斯科比亚的美丽风景和华丽宫殿深深迷住。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Now that our long winter has
passed,
I'm happy that I can now show you
our gorgeous hometown.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
漫长的冬季终于过去，我很高兴现在能向你展示我们华丽的家乡。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you feel like visiting Moscovia
take the chance now!
I'll help you to have a nice trip
to Moscovia!
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果你想去莫斯科比亚参观，现在就抓住机会吧！
我会帮你安排一次愉快的莫斯科比亚之旅！

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, let us start now.
You should pay me 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia.
But when you come back,
you don't have to pay.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
好的，那我们现在就开始。
前往莫斯科比亚需要支付我 10,000 泽尼。
不过当你回来时，就不需要付费了。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Can we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
我们现在可以出发了吗？

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出发！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果你现在太忙，随时都可以再告诉我。
我随时准备引导任何人前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sorry but you don't have
enough zeny now
You need 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
抱歉，你现在的泽尼不足。
前往莫斯科比亚需要 10,000 泽尼。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, we're leaving now.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
好的，那我们现在出发。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果你现在太忙，随时都可以再告诉我。
我随时准备引导任何人前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
How was your trip?
Do you have good memories from Moscovia?
A ship is now leaving
for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
旅途如何？
你在莫斯科比亚留下了美好的回忆吗？
现在有一艘船正驶往卢恩·米德加兹。

scripts.text: Return to Alberta
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you want to see more
please take your time.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果你想看更多，请慢慢欣赏。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Please come and visit soon.
Ok then, Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
请尽快再来参观。
好的，那我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Our dear Csar Alexsay III is in the palace.
He rules over Moscovia.
Please be careful not to cause him any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们敬爱的沙皇 亚历克赛三世正在宫殿里。
他统治着莫斯科比亚。
请注意不要给他带来任何麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please be silent or the Csar will be angry.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
请保持安静，否则沙皇会生气的。
